Subject: New season arrivals — worth a look
Preview: It's been a while. Here's what came in for the new season.
Body: Hey,

It's been a bit since we've seen you, and we figured it was worth reaching out.

The new season arrivals are in. Nothing flashy to announce — just gear that showed up, got sorted, and is ready to head out with you.

If you've got a trip on the calendar, or you're just starting to think about one, take a look at what's new. We've kept the catalog honest: specs are listed as tested, and we'll tell you what each piece is built for and what it isn't.

When you're ready, the new arrivals are waiting.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
